description: Delegation Budget (agent allowances): a parent budget's OWNER gives a child agent its own bounded allowance: human/company -> supervisor agent -> workers -> sub-agents (4 levels). The child can only NARROW the parent: cap <= parent, per-purchase max, allowed payees (subset), blocked payees (inherited), velocity limit (purchases/hour), expiry <= parent. Every child spend is checked against and counted in every ancestor, so the company cap holds across the whole tree; freezing a parent stops all descendants; budget/status shows spend by child. Header X-Budget-Key = the parent's owner_key. Bookkeeping only. By OMENZ. (MCP calls run in AYNE, the free playzone; production: POST https://www.omenz.org/api/tollbooth/v1/budget/delegate, $0.01 via x402.)
